insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (depends on Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer: Reload of Sum Insured (activates after base SI is insufficient)
great.quote: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured ... in case the available Sum Insured which shall be considered to be inclusive of accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), is insufficient for covering a claim under the Policy as a result of previous claims in that Policy Year.
great.reference: Section C.I (h) Reload of Sum Insured
great.explanation: This provides extra cover in the same policy year once your available Sum Insured (including NCB, if any) is not enough for a later claim (subject to conditions like not for same illness in the same year).

great.name: Pre-hospitalization cover available without waiting (for OPD benefit)
great.quote: Waiting periods do not apply in respect of this Benefit.
great.explanation: For the OPD benefit, the insurer states waiting periods do not apply (useful for immediate OPD usage), subject to the OPD sub-limits in the schedule.

good.name: PED (Pre-existing disease) waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage (standard/good in the market).

good.name: Specific disease/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 Specified disease / procedure waiting period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Listed specific conditions are covered after 24 months (standard). Note: one item mentions 36 months for joint replacement under Standard Plan (plan-specific).

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident

good.name: Restore/Reload benefit: Not for same illness in same policy year (unrelated-only type)
good.quote: The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C.I (h) Reload of Sum Insured - Condition (iii)
good.explanation: Reload works only for a different illness/injury than the one already claimed in that policy year (industry-standard style restore, not the best-in-class same-illness restore).

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Home-based treatment (when hospitalization is otherwise required) is covered, subject to conditions and exclusions.

good.name: Air ambulance / emergency evacuation assistance (Domestic)
good.quote: Domestic Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Emergency evacuation assistance including air ambulance is available for travel within India (subject to the service conditions).

good.name: Air ambulance / emergency evacuation assistance (International)
good.quote: International Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Emergency evacuation/repatriation assistance outside India is available for trips <90 days (subject to conditions).

good.name: NCB / Renewal bonus present but reduces after a claim (partial protection)
good.quote: The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 50% of the Sum Insured ... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
good.explanation: NCB exists (up to 50%). After a claim, it reduces by 10% of Sum Insured next year (so it does not reset to zero immediately, but it does reduce).

good.name: Optional cover trade-off: PPN Discount with co-pay outside Preferred Provider Network
good.quote: If this option is chosen ... discount of 10% on the premium... If the Insured Person takes Inpatient hospitalization ... in a Hospital other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then the Policyholder / Insured Person shall bear a Co-Payment of 15% on each and every claim
good.explanation: This is an optional discount feature. If you opt it, you save premium but pay 15% co-pay when you go outside the preferred network.

bad.name: Room rent limit: As per Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table (can trigger proportionate deductions)
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent ... up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy;
bad.reference: Section C.I (a) In-patient Hospitalization - What is covered (1)
bad.explanation: Room eligibility is not ‘any room/no limit’ in the wording; it is subject to limits in the schedule. If your entitlement is capped (common in some variants), it can materially reduce claim payouts via proportionate deductions.

bad.name: Proportionate deduction applicable if room category higher than entitlement
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed ... then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: If you choose a higher room category than allowed, the insurer will apply proportionate deductions on associated medical expenses (OT, doctor fees, nursing etc., as defined). This is a major claim-impacting clause when room rent is capped by the plan.

bad.name: Consumables not covered (as per non-medical expenses list) — out-of-pocket items like gloves, masks etc.
bad.quote: Activ Care Policy Wordings - Annexure - I - List of Non-medical expenses ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED
bad.reference: Annexure I – List of Non-medical expenses
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables/non-medical items are listed as not payable/subsumed; in practice this often leads to out-of-pocket expenses. (The policy also says 'allowable consumables' in hospitalization, but the annexure explicitly excludes many items.)

bad.name: Disease sub-limits: Sublimit for listed illnesses (amount per schedule)
bad.quote: Sublimit for listed illnesses: We will cover the Medical Expenses arising out of an Insured Person’s in-patient Hospitalization for the listed Illness/ conditions and limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table.
bad.reference: Section C.I (j) Sublimit for listed illnesses
bad.explanation: Disease-wise sublimits (as per schedule) are a red flag because they can significantly reduce payout for common procedures/conditions.

bad.name: Domiciliary hospitalization: long list of conditions not covered under this benefit
bad.quote: We shall not be liable to pay for any claim made under this Beneﬁt in connection with: (1) Asthma... (5) Diabetes mellitus and insipidus; ... (7) Hypertension; ...
bad.reference: Section C.I (e) Domiciliary Hospitalization - What is not covered
bad.explanation: Even though domiciliary hospitalization is covered, many common chronic conditions are excluded from this specific benefit, limiting usefulness.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization days limit (number of days not stated in the excerpt)
unclear.quote: We shall cover ... the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred ... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: The wording points to the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table for the number of days. Verify the exact pre-hospitalization day limit for your plan.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization days limit (number of days not stated in the excerpt)
unclear.quote: We shall cover ... the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses ... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: The wording points to the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table for the number of days. Verify the exact post-hospitalization day limit for your plan.

unclear.name: Co-pay amount for age 61+ not specified in wording (depends on Product Benefit Table/Policy Schedule)
unclear.quote: if the Age ... is 61 years or above... shall bear a Co-payment per claim ... as speciﬁed in Product Beneﬁt Table/Policy Schedule.
unclear.explanation: A mandatory co-pay applies at entry age 61+ but the percentage is not mentioned here. Check your schedule/benefit table for the exact co-pay.

unclear.name: Cashless hospital network size not specified
unclear.quote: Cashless Facilities can be availed only at Our Network Providers/ Empanelled Service Providers. The complete list of Network Providers and Empaneled Service Providers is available on Our website
unclear.explanation: The document does not state number of network hospitals. Confirm network size and key hospitals in your city from the insurer’s website.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
